stories.title: Druski's "That's So Zion" skit roasts grown-up Disney child stars
stories.summary: Druski posted a sketch as Zion, the grown-up star of a fake Disney Channel sitcom called "That's So Zion," captioned "Kid Stars growup & be so Unpredictable" (322K likes). Viewers spotted riffs on Raven-Symoné, Orlando Brown and JoJo Siwa, and Raven-Symoné answered "I'm 💀 hahha. I AM GAY" and "you kilt it!" The same day Pete Hegseth confirmed the Pentagon would livestream the firing-squad execution of Fort Hood shooter Nidal Hasan.
